First, the user asked about the board members. The initial plan was to use WebSurfer to find the current members and their professional histories. WebSurfer did that and found the list, which included Tim Cook, Arthur Levinson, James Bell, Ron Sugar, Al Gore, Sue Wagner, and Andrea Young.

Then, WebSurfer started scrolling through the page to find more details about each member. It found that Tim Cook was the CEO, Arthur Levinson was the chairman of Genentech, James Bell was a former CFO of Boeing, Ron Sugar was a former CEO of Northrop Grumman, Al Gore was a former Vice President, Sue Wagner co-founded BlackRock, and Andrea Young was a former CEO of Avon.

But when it got to Andrea Young, WebSurfer didn't find any C-suite positions before she joined Apple. It only found her work as a legislative assistant and later as a chief of staff and vice president. So, the mistake was that WebSurfer didn't realize that Andrea Young didn't hold a C-suite position before joining the board.
